summary: Check whether an object visibly communicates assembly, support and intended degrees of freedom.
objective: A reviewer can identify the main parts and explain which move together using the visible object.
example_prompts: Check whether an object visibly communicates assembly, support and intended degrees of freedom.

principles: Assess the declared object story, not compliance with a single art style. A floating fantasy object can pass if its intended support logic is explicit.
Prioritize silhouette, connections and articulation before tiny surface detail.
implementation: Inspect overview, underside and one joint close-up. Record missing connections, unintended penetrations and parts whose purpose cannot be identified.
Exercise the full authored motion range slowly; compare endpoints against saved joint locations.
For the shelter trace the frame; for the limb follow segment attachment; for a mechanism inspect fixed housing versus rotating shaft.
observable_checks: A reviewer can identify the main parts and explain which move together using the visible object.
Every unexplained gap, overlap or support ambiguity is either corrected or documented as an intentional visual choice.

known_limits: Visual coherence is not structural engineering, anatomical certification or collision verification.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.
